no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting for this NDA because this drug product was designated Breakthrough and there were no major issues that needed additional advisory committee input.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Viekira Pak (NDA206619). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader Review, Office Director Memo, and Medical Review) consistently state that an AdComm was not warranted because the product had Breakthrough Therapy designation, demonstrated virologic response rates exceeding 95%, and presented no review issues requiring outside advice. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
